title: Turkey Burgers
instructions: Mix all ingredients together, let rest 5 min, form 2 wide patties, air fry at 190°C for 11–13 min flipping halfway.
notes: Optional: use lettuce, tomato, and onion as a bun substitute.

title: Veggie Burger
instructions: Steam vegetables until soft, mash, mix with egg and breadcrumbs, form patties, bake or air fry at 180°C for 12–15 min.
notes: Optional: top with tomato or lettuce.

title: Heart-Healthy Banana Cocoa Cake
instructions: Mash bananas, mix with eggs and oil, add oats, cocoa, and baking powder, bake at 180°C for 25-30 min.
notes: Slice and enjoy with cocoa or banana topping.

title: Banana Chocolate Oat Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients, pour into baking tray, bake at 180°C for 25 min, cool and serve.

title: Fillet Steak with Potatoes
instructions: Grill or pan-fry steak to preferred doneness. Boil or roast potatoes, serve together with olive oil.

title: Fillet Steak with Mushrooms
instructions: Cook steak and mushrooms, serve with potatoes and drizzle olive oil on top.

title: Turkey Burger Wrap
instructions: Prepare turkey patties as above, serve wrapped in lettuce leaves with tomato and onion.

title: Veggie Burger Wrap
instructions: Prepare veggie patty as above, serve wrapped in lettuce leaves with tomato and onion.

title: Heart-Healthy Cake with Banana & Cocoa
instructions: Mash bananas, mix with eggs and oil, add oats, cocoa, baking powder. Bake at 180°C for 25–30 min.
notes: Serve with a thin banana slice or cocoa sprinkle.

title: Banana Chocolate Oats Cake
instructions: Mix all ingredients, pour into tray, bake at 180°C for 25 min, cool before slicing.

title: Skyr & Eggs
instructions: Serve skyr cold. Fry eggs separately and drizzle with olive oil.

title: Chicken & Rice
instructions: Cook chicken and rice separately. Serve together with olive oil.
